[[Surkhon Termez]] |continentalcup1= |continentalcup1 qualifiers= |continentalcup2= |continentalcup2 qualifiers= |league topscorer= [[Valeriy Kechinov]] [[FC Pakhtakor Tashkent]] (22 goals) |biggest home win= |biggest away win= |highest scoring= |matches= |total goals= |longest wins= |longest unbeaten= |longest losses= |highest attendance = |lowest attendance= |average attendance= |prevseason= |nextseason=[[1993 Uzbek League|1993]] }} The '''1992 [[Uzbek League]] season''' was the first edition of top level football in [[Uzbekistan]] since independence from the [[Soviet Union]] in 1992. 17 teams took part in the championship which was won by both [[FC Pakhtakor Tashkent|Pakhtakor Tashkent]] and [[FK Neftchi Farg'ona|Neftchi Farg'ona]] whom finished the championship on 51 points and therefore shared the first ever Uzbek League title. [[FC Pakhtakor Tashkent|Pakhtakor Tashkent]] were also put forward to enter the first [[Commonwealth of Independent States Cup]] as league champions for the 1993 campaign. [[FK Rush-Milk Shahrixon|Shahrixonchi Shahrixon]], [[Kimyogar Olmaliq]] and [[Surkhon Termez]] were relegated ==Teams== The League was contested by 17 teams, three of whom would be relegated. ==League
